title: Lever Catalog Template (Sprint 26 WS-B)
description: Schema for a single lever template in the git-owned, versioned lever catalog (data-platform/decision/levers/<role>.yaml), per design spec Sec 3.3 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-23-sprint-26-decision-ontology-actionable-insight-design.md). A lever is a typed recommendation template dispatched by lever_id from the recommendation beat of the DC-INSIGHT-v1 contract (data/synthetic/schema/dc-insight-v1.schema.json); role and owner_role may differ to encode a cross-role handoff (e.g. OOA recommends, DCA owns). impact_formula_ref is the stable dispatch key the compute_expected_impact tool implements.

preconditions.description: Human-readable conditions that must hold before this lever is recommendable, e.g. ward.occupancy_pct > threshold.

params_schema.description: Nested JSON-schema-ish fragment describing this lever's params. Intentionally left open (not additionalProperties:false) because it is itself a schema fragment, not catalog data.

impact_formula_ref.description: Stable dispatch key the compute_expected_impact tool implements, e.g. expedite_discharge_beds.

owner_role.description: Role responsible for executing this lever once approved; may differ from role to encode a cross-role handoff.

hitl.description: Always true: every lever requires human-in-the-loop approval before execution.

effect.description: Declarative state mutation applied to SimState when the action is HITL-approved (Sprint 38, ADR-0058). Interpreted by apps/sim-capacity/src/closedloop/effect.py.
